title: VM bootstrap health
description: C:\ProgramData\DbHubDemo\health.json on T1 and the T2 host. Write-DemoVmHealth writes it after every run of the bootstrap state machine (ADR 0003), and the validator reads it through Run Command (ADR 0012). It is redacted and never holds secrets.

role.description: EvalArcVm is the opt-in evaluation-only T2 (t2Mode EvaluationOnlyAzureVm, ADR 0006).

state.description: Machine state. WaitingForArcOnboarding and WaitingForProductKey wait for the orchestrator (Phase 7); WaitingForGuestSql waits for the T2 guest's SQL Server before the workload runner is installed in it (Phase 13); WaitingForInput waits for other input, such as the runner's Run Command chunks; ManualActionRequired carries operator instructions.

status.description: ADR 0012 status: Ready is Pass (Warning when warnings exist), Failed is Fail, ManualActionRequired is Manual action required, and in-flight states are Warning.

generation.description: <bundle SHA-256 prefix>-<loader run UTC>; a new generation re-checks every step.

warnings.description: For example, media trusted on first use because no SHA-256 was pinned.

details.description: Role-specific facts: host size and Secure Boot, guest state over PowerShell Direct, evaluation days left, SQL Server edition and version, and Arc onboarding.
